data.rationale: The proposal gets the same procedure in the right order (two Xe conversions to USD, timeanddate city lookup, email to procurement with subject "Quotes: <item>", cheaper and time in the body), but it is vague on details. It says "Discard/send" when the true workflow requires Discard and never Send. It omits the recipient address, the Mail tab and body-typing specifics, and the exact body format. It also splits each amount and currency into separate parameters, where the true workflow uses a single quote_a or quote_b value for both.
